description: The second-order induction sentence is true under full semantics exactly when every subset containing the interpreted zero and closed under the interpreted successor is the entire domain.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize_inductionSentence.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  {M : Type w} [L.Structure M] (z : L.Functions 0) (s : L.Functions 1) (a : ℕ → M)
  (r : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.RelationAssignment M) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.fullRealize a r
      (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.SecondOrderLogic.inductionSentence z s) ↔
    ∀ (P : M → Prop),
      P (FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap z Fin.elim0) →
        (∀ (x : M), P x → P (FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap s fun x_1 => x)) → ∀ (x : M), P x
